artworks.title: Ajax and Cassandra
artworks.description: Solomon's sack of Troy — the Locrian Ajax tears Cassandra from Athena's sanctuary, the sacrilege that brought the thunderbolt and the Gyraean rocks.

artworks.title: Ajax Insulted by his Comrades
artworks.description: Barca's scene of wounded honour among the Greeks — the tradition of Ajax dishonoured at Troy, cousin in theme to the Locrian's boast on the reef and the greater Ajax's suicide.

artworks.title: Shipwreck
artworks.description: Aivazovsky's storm at sea — the divine wreck the Nostoi visit on those who robbed temples and dragged Cassandra from Pallas' image.
